title: search in

query.description: Text to find. Use exactly one of query, id or recent=true.

id.description: Read one complete note by its ID, including what superseded it. Use exactly one selector.

recent.description: Set true to list recent notes without reinforcing them. False is refused; use exactly one selector.

selection.description: Relevant covers this task's, this project's and reusable notes; without an open work session, reusable notes only. Legacy reads older unscoped notes. selection_context in the result names the scope the host searched.

limit.description: Maximum results for query or recent; unavailable with id.

exact.description: Exact word matching, available only with query.

description: Exactly one of query, id or recent=true is required. This cross-field requirement is checked by the operation; all argument types and bounds are declared here.
